newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Product Swaps - Dec gas oil seen overbought.
newsitem.headline: Asia Product Swaps - Dec gas oil seen overbought.

text.p: Singapore gas oil swaps were under some selling pressure late Friday afternoon in a technical correction to the sharp hikes in the past week, market sources said.

December gas oil swaps were last quoted at $31.35/$31.45 per barrel, down about 10 cents from midday, brokers said. December gasoil traded down throughout the day with deals done at $31.50, $31.45 and $31.40 per barrel, brokers said.
"The front month looks overbought and was offered down today," one trader said.
As a result the December/January backwardation came in slightly and was last quoted at 80-90 cents from Thursday's $1.00/$1.10, brokers said.
The backwardation also narrowed due to expectations of a second Jnauary diesel buy tender from India due to the closure of two refineries in India following a crude pipeline explosion.
The jet fuel/gas oil spread (regrade) picked up slightly after earlier strong selling pressure as players took profit, brokers said.
December regrade was last quoted at $1.50/$1.65, they brokers said.
December naphtha remained unchanged in lacklustre trade, with bids/offers notional at $23.75/$23.90 and fuel oil at $119.00/$120.00, brokers said.
